{{Quote|The whole of Felucia was like a single living thing.|PROXY|<ref name="FactFile1">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 1 (2013)|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 1 (2013)]]</ref>}}
'''Felucia''' ({{Pronounced|fʌ'luʃə}} or /fʌ'lusiə/) was a largely unsettled terrestrial jungle [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Felucia system/Legends|Felucia system]] of the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium Worlds]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Located near the junction of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] and [[Shaltin Tunnels/Legends|Shaltin Tunnels]], the world featured a hot and humid [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and significant [[Water/Legends|water]] resources beneath a surface [[Radiation/Legends|irradiated]] by [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]] light of the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Felix/Legends|Felix]]. Native [[Plant/Legends|plant]], [[Fungus/Legends|fungal]], and animal life evolved to dominate the environment in a deep symbiotic relationship, causing significant [[Force energy]] to permeate the ecosystem. The native [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Felucians]] developed [[The Force/Legends|Force-based]] tribal societies in subterranean caverns, largely undisturbed by the [[The galaxy/Legends|greater galaxy]] until [[27,000 BBY/Legends|27,000 BBY]], when the planet was discovered by [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] [[Gossam Courivers/Legends|Couriver]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] explorers/colonists from [[Castell/Legends|Castell]]. After aggressive resistance from the native wildlife indicated that the world would not support large-scale colonies, the new arrivals established hard-fought, scattered resort settlements on the surface. Early populations, comprising only wealthy Gossams and their poor servants, knew the planet as '''Galuch''' and retained colonial control over it until around [[25,126 BBY]], when [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] absorbed the world into his [[Xim's empire|empire]] as it [[Xim's Expansionist Period|expanded]] throughout the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]].

Xim's dominion fell in [[25,096 BBY]], and although Felucia changed political loyalties throughout the millennia, the world and its meager settlements of mixed-species immigrant laborers were entirely controlled by the Gossam-dominated [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] by [[700 BBY]]. These small settlements eventually developed into commercially administered [[City/Legends|cities]] like [[Kway Teow/Legends|Kway Teow]], [[Har Gau/Legends|Har Gau]], [[Jiaozi/Legends|Jiaozi]], and [[Niango/Legends|Niango]], pushing the native jungle-dwelling Felucians to retreat into the wilderness. Independent communities of escaped workers, fugitive labor organizers, and Felucian nysillin farmers maintained tenuous communities in the dangerous wilds, but the Commerce Guild retained economic and political control of their world. When the Guild allied with the anti-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Movement]] to create the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Felucia joined the rebellion movement in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as a Confederate fortress world. Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] set up a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the planet early in the war, which was [[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|unsuccessfully challenged]] by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] around the beginning of the conflict. The Republic made a more successful [[Second Battle of Felucia/Legends|second attempt]] around a [[21 BBY/Legends|year later]]. By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Commerce Guild had once again established its dominance of Felucia and Guild Presidente [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] chose it as her new headquarters and base of military operations. Its tactical significance made it a primary target in the Republic's [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], resulting in a bloody [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|months-long battle]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

The battle ended with the near-poisoning of the Felucian water supply and the mass murder of the Republic's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] with the issuance of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. The [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of violence traumatized the native ecosystem, pushing its natural energies and [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] inhabitants towards the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. During the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Maris Brood]] went into hiding in the Felucia jungles, working to bring the [[Shaman/Legends|shamanistic]] Felucian tribes away from the dark side. Master Ti was [[Mission to Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|killed]] by an [[Galen Marek|assassin]] in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], throwing the surviving Felucian shaman and Maris Brood deep into the grip of the dark side. The natural [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] of the natives eventually caught the attention of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which prepared to exterminate the tribes in order to preempt any threat their power posed. Brood [[Battle of Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|led]] hordes of dark-sided Felucians against Imperial invaders, but was defeated after managed to kill most of the Imperial garrison. Although the Empire later maintained a presence on the planet through the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Felucia became heavily trafficked by crime syndicates like the [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|chapter]] of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] and the rival [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] later wrested control of the world away from the Empire; it again changed hands during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], when the [[Yuuzhan Vong|alien invaders]] claimed it for their [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|Empire]]. Following the war, Felucia was colonized by [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] refugees.

==Description==
[[File:Felucia-wide.png|thumb|left|200px|Felucia's diverse jungle of various plants.]]
{{Quote|The worst thing about Felucia is the rancor!|Unidentified civilian|<ref name="Kinect Star Wars">''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''</ref>}}
Felucia had a diversity of bizarre plants (such as [[Felucian spike plant|spike]], [[Felucian spore plant|spore]], and enormous pitcher plants), [[Giant purple mushroom|fungi]], and animals which were almost rubber-like and translucent. When the sun shone, the environment glittered like multicolored glass. Most of Felucia was entirely covered by a humid, fetid landscape of huge fungal forests, and its wildlife included native [[Gelagrub/Legends|gelagrubs]], immigrated [[Acklay/Legends|acklays]], and a prodigious [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]]. Felucia had strong ties to the Living Force, and as such the world's flora and fauna, including [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Jungle Felucians]], could be influenced by a presence of a strong Force-user, both light and dark. Most plants and animals of Felucia had adapted special defenses to protect them from each other, which made them particularly hostile to off-worlders. Felucia was known to radiate a sort of life force that the native Jungle Felucians were capable of feeling.<ref name="TFUCG" />

==History==
===Early history===
[[File:FeluciaMoons-PL.png|thumb|left|200px|The two moons of Felucia]]
Originally known as '''Galuch''', the planet was colonized by the [[Gossam Courivers/Legends|Gossam Courivers]] in [[27,000 BBY/Legends|27,000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> early in their interstellar history. Felucia was a hard planet to colonize because of its dense forests and creatures. When the Gossams tried to colonize it, many aggressive plants and animals tried to defend the planet, but the Gossams finally gained a few footholds on it. Felucia was one of their earliest colonies, though it was one of the least populated since its vast fungus jungles proved too wild to support large Gossam colonies. As such, the planet became little more that an exotic retreat world for the wealthy Gossam along with their lowly servants and laborers. Circa [[25,126 BBY]], the planet was absorbed into [[Xim's empire]] as [[Xim/Legends|he]] expanded his borders from the [[Kingdom of Cron]].
At some point, another species of [[Felucian/Legends|Felucians]] came to live on the planet from offworld. They were a diminutive, reptilian race, related to the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]], subsisting on farming and commerce.<ref name="TEA" />

Sometime before [[700 BBY]], the planet began to be controlled entirely by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], and resistance to the Guild was found in scattered townships in the wilderness. These townships were home to escaped workers, criminals, and enemies of the Guild. As colonies spread, the native Jungle Felucian species went underground or lived in small villages in the thickest forests. Many, if not all, of the Jungle Felucians were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], and had a communal relationship with the planet's ecosystem.

Around [[53 BBY/Legends|53 BBY]], Felucia became a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. A little over two months after, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] took up his post on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and Felucia was given a seat in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. The move was viewed by some as a way for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to secure greater support in the Senate. Indeed, some senators, chief amongst them the delegate from [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], openly viewed [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]] as a mere "client world" of the Trade Federation.<ref name="DP" />

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|On Felucia, the Seps dug their metal heels into the muck of that alien hellhole and dared the Republic to come in after them. So we did, only to be met with month after month of flesh-eating diseases, shrieking nocturnal predators, and other sights that haunt me to this day...|Anonymous [[501st Legion/Legends|501st]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]|<ref name="BFII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Nicillin_farmers.png|thumb|left|200px|A [[Nysillin/Legends|nysillin]] farm on Felucia]]
Felucia became the headquarters of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]],<ref name="TEA" /> which supported the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the CIS and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="EPII">{{Film|II}}</ref> Felucia would become a valuable member world for the Separatists.<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Holocron Heist Date">{{TCWdates|201}}</ref> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] were involved in a futile [[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|battle]] for the planet.<ref name="Holocron Heist">{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}</ref> Around [[21 BBY]], a [[duel on Felucia]] was waged between Kenobi and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="TEA" />

A farming community existed on the planet to grow the [[Nysillin/Legends|nysillin]] that served as a medical herb. The reptilian [[Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] farmers were later terrorized by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]], who demanded that the settlement hand over their harvest. In order to protect themselves, the farmers hired a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] which consisted of [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]], [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], [[Seripas/Legends|Seripas]] and [[Rumi Paramita/Legends|Rumi Paramita]]. The Galactic Republic also established a [[Felucia medical station/Legends|medical station]] in orbit around the planet in order to treat [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] wounded in battle. However, the Confederacy staged an assault that destroyed the space station and deployed a [[Automated vulture droid deployment station/Legends|station]] that held [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] to destroy any intruders.

Felucia's proximity to several important [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] made it an important target for both sides of the war, and the campaigns on the planet dragged on. At one point, Ahsoka Tano was kidnapped by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] headhunters during the push to take a [[Separatist outpost (Felucia)/Legends|Separatist outpost]].<ref name="PL">{{TCW|Padawan Lost}}</ref> Late in the war, the planet was named by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine as part of a "[[Triad of Evil/Legends|Triad of Evil]]," alongside [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] and [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]].<ref name="LoE" />

[[File:Felucia_TEA.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Felucia.]]The Republic later sent the [[182nd Legion]] to Felucia to fight Separatist troops on the planet. One month later, contact with the legion had been lost, and the Republic sent the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] to [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|fight]] the Separatists. The 501st were confronted by Acklay and flesh-eating diseases for many weeks. The horror of the battle was so bad that one [[Retired clone trooper|clone]] said they would have been driven insane, if not for the Jedi [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]. A group of clones were sent to find a missing AT-TE in the Felucian forest. There they found that Acklay had killed the occupants, but the clones protected their platoon by killing the acklay. After retrieving power cells from a crashed [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]], the clones reactivated the AT-TE and finally broke through the Separatists' front line by damaging their artillery.<ref name="BFII" />

The planet was attacked during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. After the first attack, in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Zonder/Legends|Zonder]] were imprisoned on the planet. [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] took the [[Intrepid (Venator-class)|''Intrepid'']] to Felucia to capture [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] and rescue Barriss and Zonder; meanwhile, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] began their [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attack]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

With the help of Padawan [[Ekria/Legends|Ekria]], [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] rescued Barriss and [[Zonder/Legends|Zonder]] from the [[Nigkoe Detention Facility/Legends|Nigkoe Detention Facility]], resulting in a full-fledged ground battle. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces then assaulted [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai's]] personal compound, not realizing Mai had already evacuated and was on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] infiltrated the compound and found Mai long gone, but managed to shut down the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] remotely, letting [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly's]] clone troops into the compound, at the same time the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] was crashing onto Coruscant.

Unfortunately, the compound was booby-trapped, and released toxins, killing many clones. The Jedi barely escaped before the entire compound exploded, but many clones did not. The trap also triggered a "poisoned well" policy to keep the planet from being of worth to the Republic, unleashing a highly poisonous biological agent into the water supply of Felucia's natural planet-wide aquatic distribution system, capable of infecting the entire planet in four days.

[[File:CloneLieutenantGalleOnFelucia.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Clone troopers on the surface of Felucia]]
Shu Mai had left behind forces ordered to fortify the planet's major water-treatment facilities. They knew the only way to prevent the deaths of millions was to take over the facilities and contain the toxin. The [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] sent [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]] with clone reinforcements to Felucia.

Stass dropped off the clone reinforcements and Padawan [[Drake Lo'gaan/Legends|Drake Lo'gaan]] on Felucia and then headed to [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]]. The Republic forces split into three forces, each headed toward a different facility: Barriss, Lieutenant [[Inc]], and Lieutenant [[Barr]] to [[Har Gau/Legends|Har Gau]]; Ekria, Zonder, Drake, and Lieutenant [[Galle/Legends|Galle]] to [[Jiaozi/Legends|Jiaozi]]; and Aayla and Commander Bly to [[Niango/Legends|Niango]].

Barriss' forces defeated a Commerce Guild patrol, at the cost of Lieutenant Inc's life. Barriss ordered Lieutenant Barr's troops to abandon her and go get Lieutenant Galle for help.

Meanwhile, Lieutenant Galle used a staged retreat to distract the Commerce Guild forces from the facility at Jiaozi, which the Padawans were able to infiltrate. The Padawans completed their mission at Jiaozi by shutting down the outgoing pipes before the arrival of the toxin, but were unable to access the controls of the Niango and Har Gau.

Ekria was puzzled when she detected a Confederacy-encrypted [[Hologram/Legends|holo]] from Coruscant being received by Bly, not understanding that it was Darth Sidious relaying [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. Ekria was able to tap into the [[clone-cam]] feeds of Bly's troops and behold Aayla, who was spooked by the complete silence of the wildlife as she and Bly headed towards Niango. As Aayla was distracted by a native bird taking to the air, she was gunned down from behind by Bly and the other clones.

Simultaneously, Barriss was fighting alone, surrounded by droids. To her relief, she saw Lieutenant Galle's men seemingly rush to her rescue, but instead they shot her down.

The Padawans were horrified by Aayla's murder, but able to decrypt the message and hear Order 66. They then heard a new message on Republic channels from Coruscant: "Calling all Jedi. This is [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The war is over. I repeat, the war is over. All Jedi are ordered to return to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] immediately. You will receive further instructions when you arrive."<ref name="rof">''[[Reversal of Fortune]]''</ref>

The Padawans then checked Galle's clone-cam, and saw that Galle's troops were about to burst into the Jiaozi facility to kill the Padawans.<ref name="rof" /> The Padawans barely escaped, and would later head to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="ea:r">''[[Evasive Action: Recruitment]]''</ref>

===Later events===
{{Quote|This planet is evil. It corrupted me! But you... you can save me. Just let me get away from here...|[[Maris Brood]]|<ref name="TFUvg">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>}}
Since their defeat, [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist remnants]], including [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] settlers, found shelter in small enclaves in the fungal wilderness, joining forces with fugitive laborers, [[Zann Consortium/Legends|outlaws]] and smugglers they formerly persecuted.<ref name="TFUCG" />

[[File:ShaakTi_vs_Starkiller.jpg|thumb|left|260px|Starkiller duels Shaak Ti.]]
After the Clone Wars, the damage to the ecosystem combined with the pain and suffering felt on the planet caused many of the force sensitive [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Jungle Felucians]] to teeter dangerously close to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. This made Felucia an even more dangerous place, in many years to come. Sometime before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] conquered the planet, after the world's capture, they destroyed any [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|local resistance]]. In the aftermath of Felucia's fall, the Empire began to occupy the world. The Imperial forces maintained presence in [[Kway Teow/Legends|Kway Teow]] primarily to gather Gossam slaves for export and to research biological agents takes from diverse and abundant plant life.<ref name="TFUCG" /> However, the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Consortium]] continued to offer freedom for the locals against the Empire.

During the [[3 BBY/Legends|late days]] of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] sent his secret apprentice [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]] to Felucia to [[Mission to Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|deal]] with [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] there. Master [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] had exiled herself to this planet, where she was training the grief-stricken [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Maris Brood]], and Jungle Felucians for a confrontation with the Dark Lord. Starkiller fought his way through a small army of Jungle Felucian warriors and engaged Shaak Ti in a lightsaber duel. Despite Master Ti summoning more Jungle Felucians and even calling on the assistance of a [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]], Starkiller defeated her in combat, and after informing Marek about how he could be "so much more" if he turned to the light, she then purposely fell into the pit and conceded her defeat. Marek attempted to save her as she began her plummet, but her body exploded in blue light as she died, causing him to turn back and shield his eyes, this had further plundered Felucia to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]]. Not realizing that Ti was dead, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] came to convince the Jedi to join his rebellion. Maris, who had been driven insane by the dark side, kidnapped the senator to use to bargain with Darth Vader. However, [[2 BBY/Legends|one year later]], a reformed Starkiller redeemed himself by [[Battle of Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|rescuing]] the Senator. After dueling Maris, he allowed her to live, something that Organa condemned, likening her to Darth Vader. The Empire began operations on the planet to eliminate the [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|native Force sensitives]] and established a prison facility, from which agents of [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] rescued Admiral [[Gilder Varth]].

[[File:ZannConsortiumFelucia-FoC.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Crime lord [[Tyber Zann]] with [[Zann Consortium/Legends|his forces]] on the world]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] had sent a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] that he spent half his wealth on to Felucia to be protected by the Empire, where it was [[Battle of Felucia (Zann Consortium)|stolen]] by the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]]. It was during this time that [[Tyber Zann]] here led a contingent of his underworld mercenaries against the Imperial forces. However, Zann would get captured by Imperial forces as part of a trap set up by Jabba, although he would later [[Ground Battle on Kessel|escape]].<ref name="EaW FoC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>

Sometime afterward, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] liberated Felucia from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] rule and ended their reign on the planet.

After the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]], following the [[Battle of Ithor|devastation]] of their homeworld, [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], sought to a new homeworld. Many of the survivors built colonies on [[Öetrago/Legends|Öetrago]], [[Upell]], Felucia<ref name="TEA" /> and, eventually, [[Borao]].<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Felucia_dawn.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Felucian landscape]]
Felucia was created for [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. Early concept art for the planet depicted a world of enormous bulbous plants that seeped antigravitic goo into the skies, which later evolved to become the planet [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] (at the time, named "Falucia").<ref name="db" /> Originally designed for an opening montage of Confederacy planets under assault by the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] Republic, Felucia later was used during the [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] montage scene, serving as the place of the death of fan favorite [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]. The planet was later explored in the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] media such as [[Paul Ens]]' webstrip [[Reversal of Fortune|''Evasive Action: Reversal of Fortune'']] and the ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' multimedia project. The planet has been featured in the video games ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]'' as playable battleground. With its background expanded in ''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]'' and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', Felucia has also appeared in [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|Season Two]] and [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|Season Three]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.
